map.膜厚为什么用微米？: Why is film thickness measured in microns?
map.表面处理膜厚通常为几至几十微米（μm），换算成 m 是小数量级，用 μm 更直观: Surface-treatment film thickness is usually a few to a few tens of microns (μm); converting to m gives a very small number, so μm is more intuitive and avoids decimal errors.
map.实际用量为何大于理论？: Why is the actual usage greater than the theoretical?
map.喷涂有飞散损耗、电镀有电流效率与边角增厚，实际用量通常乘 1.1–1.3 损耗系: Spraying has overspray loss, and electroplating has current-efficiency loss and edge thickening; the actual usage is usually multiplied by a 1.1-1.3 loss factor.
